title: Run browser work
goal: Start periodic WASM work; stop with its owned lifetime.

selectionNotes: WASM lifetime; no durable work after tab/process termination.

runtime.reason: Native WASM hosted-service integration is introduced in .NET 11.
runtime.name: .NET

sdk.reason: Matching WebAssembly SDK, runtime packs and browser assets.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Canonical language mode; no C# 15-only syntax is required.
language.name: C#

packages.reason: Actual restored RC2 host and matching browser assets. DevServer at this version supplies local serving only.
packages.name: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly

prerequisites: Use the complete standalone BlazorWebAssembly SDK project, explicit imports/namespaces, document and JS/CSS supplied in Markdown. Actual SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; DevServer and WebAssembly package 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105. No native workload or AOT is needed.

Register IHostedService with AddHostedService before Build and RunAsync. StartAsync must yield promptly; own and await the running task. The sample has local in-memory instrumentation only, no persistence provider or external service.

An explicit live-document owner calls public WebAssemblyHost.DisposeAsync; .NET 11 stops registered services before disposing the renderer and provider. This demonstrates orderly resource disposal, not completion of RunAsync or runtime exit.
constraints: WASM browser lifetime; not durable work after tab/process termination.

No public RunAsync cancellation overload exists. Browser close/reload/navigation do not guarantee asynchronous cleanup or StopAsync. Never depend on a final browser upload; durable work belongs to a backend.
Timers are best effort and throttled in hidden/suspended tabs; hosted services do not create worker threads. Await short iterations and pass cancellation into real I/O.

RC2 host stop uses CancellationToken.None and suppresses stop errors; services must bound/report their own cleanup. Observe actual cancelled/stopped/root-disposed events, not merely a successful disposal return.

The .NET 10 manual owner is a compiled and executed comparison, not a route to the new integration. Static SSR, Interactive Server/Auto composition, mobile suspension, AOT and GA are not execution claims.

sources.title: Pinned RC2 host startup, disposal and RunAsync limits

evidence.scope: Actual pinned SDK build only. Separate real WASM browser execution proves startup, responsive UI, timer cancellation, awaited service stop, root disposal and no further ticks after owned in-app shutdown. Exact source/artifact fingerprints and limits: docs/verification/PIN-791.md. No mocks or cross-compilation.
